optionAssessments: fehlerhaft: Correct intended faulty sensor because reported values are wrong.

intakt: An intact sensor could be miscalibrated rather than physically broken; intactness is not established by accuracy alone.
reviewed.finding: Wrong readings do not rule out precision. Replace orthogonal technical-status distractors and ask specifically whether readings are correct.
